pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Āḷaviyaṃ viharati Aggāḷave cetiye.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kosiyakārake upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vadenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.3: bahū āvuso kosakārake pacatha, amhākaṃ pi dassatha,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.4: mayam pi icchāma kosiyamissakaṃ santhataṃ kātun ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.6: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā amhe upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vakkhanti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.8: amhākaṃ pi alābhā amhākaṃ pi dulladdhaṃ ye mayaṃ ājīvassa hetu puttadārassa kāraṇā bahū khuddake pāṇe saṃghātaṃ āpādemā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.9: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.10: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te . . . vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.11: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kosiyakārake upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vakkhanti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.13: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.14: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave kosiyakārake upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vadetha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.19: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā kosiyakārake upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vakkhatha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.21: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--;
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.22: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.23.1: yo pana bhikkhu kosiyamissakaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:2.1.8: ekena pi kosiyaṃsunā missitvā karoti vā kārāpeti vā, payoge dukkaṭaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:2.1.10: nissajjitabbaṃ saṃghassa vā gaṇassa vā puggalassa vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:2.1.13: idaṃ me bhante kosiyamissakaṃ santhataṃ kārāpitaṃ nissaggiyaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:2.2.1: attanā vippakataṃ attanā pariyosāpeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:2.2.2: attanā vippakataṃ parehi pariyosāpeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:2.2.3: parehi vippakataṃ attanā pariyosāpeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:2.2.4: parehi vippakataṃ parehi pariyosāpeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:2.2.5: aññass' atthāya karoti vā kārāpeti vā, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:2.2.6: aññena kataṃ paṭilabhitvā paribhuñjati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
